acceptanceCriteria: A supported command rewrites citations whose anchored content moved but is unchanged, and refuses changed content.
Unanchored line citations are reported by the citations check.
body: Found 2026-10-20 by pre-1.0 lanes on origin/main 7d78a56b0 / a148e3a92, Corvint build 695, Darwin arm64, go1.27.3. V1-0328 lane: inserting lines in internal/contextindex/index.go moved 13 anchored citations across 4 docs whose content hashes were unchanged. Each lane writes a scratch remap script. FRONTIER-DECISION-BRIEF-2026-08-29.md has an unanchored citation that drifted silently.

completion.reason: Delivered on main c9ca8beff43d8f548b054d3b3d40e3054cecf816 via batch beamfall/corvint#1399 (lane #1393); CI green on that commit (runs 39571877340). title: Line citations: no repin for content-identical moves; inserting lines shifts many anchored citations
